args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable power bank

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater for evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops/beach sandals
- Hat/cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- Beach towel
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag
- Rash guard/swim shirt
- Water shoes

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots/shoes
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Quick-dry hiking pants/shorts
- Lightweight long-sleeve shirts (sun protection)
- Small backpack/daypack
- Reusable water bottle
- Insect repellent

TOILETRIES:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Prescription medications
- First aid kit
- Lip balm with SPF

ELECTRONICS:
- Laptop/tablet (optional)
- Headphones
- Travel adapter (if needed)
- Memory cards for camera

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books/magazines for downtime
- Travel pillow
- Snacks for travel days
- Reusable shopping bags
- Small umbrella or rain jacket

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- June 11 (Waikiki Beach): Beach games, cooler
- June 12 (Hanauma Bay snorkeling): Underwater camera
- June 13 (Diamond Head hike): Trekking poles, trail map
- June 14 (Pearl Harbor): Respectful attire
- June 15 (North Shore road trip): Car snacks, playlist
- June 16 (Luau): Hawaiian shirt/dress (aloha attire)
- June 18 (Kailua Beach kayaking): Waterproof watch
- June 19 (Shopping): Reusable shopping bags
